notes: Summary: Velarium runs real-time shipment tracking + conversational ops for enterprise shippers. Looking for reserved capacity to guarantee 99.95% availability + throughput for peak windows.
Business ask: Minimum sustained throughput guarantee for core chat and reranking pipelines; elastic burst during daily load spikes (06:00-10:00 PT).

Target metrics (Velarium proposal): min sustained 2,000 tokens/sec regionally, concurrency cap 150 concurrent streams, burst up to 5,000 tokens/sec for 5 minutes, p95 generation latency <= 250ms for 512-token responses.

Redwood proposal notes: can hit sustained 1,800 tps on 6xH100 equivalent with smart batching and prefix cache; recommend 8xH100 reserved for contractual 2k tps with 15% headroom. Quantized fallback (8-bit) can preserve latency under heavy load at reduced cost.
Negotiation points: measurement window (30d rolling) vs monthly window; SLA credit cadence (hourly or daily); explicit definition of 'tokens/sec' measurement (decoded tokens vs input tokens).

Security & compliance: require SSO (SAML) integration, SOC2 attestation, audit logging with 1yr retention, KMS for key management, and US data residency for core logs. Security review in progress; retention controls checklist requested.

POC/validation plan: 1) Staging throughput test (synthetic traces) — target sustained 2k tps for 1 hour; 2) Canary: split traffic 10% -> dedicated pool for 2 weeks; 3) Load window simulation during morning spike + end-of-month batch reranks.
